An object in motion tends to remain in motion and an object at rest tends to remain at rest unless acted upon by a force. That means that the natural state of objects is to not move.

So, why would I change this law?

Ever since I began parenting, Newton's first law of motion has become my nemesis. My kids are constantly in motion. And, when they are at rest they tend to want to be at rest. They never want to do what I want them to do. And, when they're in motion? Good luck getting them to stop.
